data.name: Josselyn
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin Joscelin, meaning 'Joseph' and 'God's deliverance'. This name has roots in the Old Testament, referencing the biblical figure Joseph, who was saved from potential harm and went on to become a leader and interpreter of dreams.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine protection and deliverance.

in_hebrew.name: ג'וסלין
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים יוסיף עוד - God will add more
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ג'וסלין נגזר מהמילה העברית 'יוסף' שפירושה 'אלוהים יוסיף עוד'. זהו שם שמקורו בתנ''ך, ומשמעותו הרחבה היא שאלוהים יוסיף או יגדיל את הברכה והטוב. השם קשור לנושא של תוספת והגדלה ברוחניות ובחומר.

in_greek.name: Γιοσέλυν
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός προσθέτει περισσότερο - God adds more
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γιοσέλυν είναι παράγωγο του εβραϊκού ονόματος 'Ιωσήφ', που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός προσθέτει περισσότερο'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ιωσήφ συνδέεται με τον πατέρα του Ιησού, τον Ιωσήφ τον Νυμφοφόρο. Το όνομα αυτό έχει μεγάλη σημασία στην παράδοση των Χριστιανών.

in_latin.name: Josselyn
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Josselyn derivatur ex hebraico nomine 'Joseph', quod significat 'Deus addit'. In ecclesia primitiva Christiana, nomen Joseph erat nomen sacrum, quod recordabatur de sanctitate et justitia. Nomen Josselyn habet profundam significationem spiritualem et culturalem in traditione Christiana.

in_english.name: Josselyn
in_english.long_meaning: The name Josselyn originates from the Hebrew name 'Joseph,' meaning 'God will add or increase.' It carries a rich biblical heritage, reflecting the idea of divine addition or multiplication. Historically, the name has been associated with qualities of faith, loyalty, and perseverance. In Christian tradition, Josselyn symbolizes spiritual growth and abundance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Josselyn echoes a rich Anglo-Saxon and Latin heritage with its emphasis on the Christian figure of Joseph. This name adds a noble and ancient element to one's identity and suggests strength and steadiness, especially in a leadership role.
data.spiritual_significance: Josselyn is a name that carries the message of God's deliverance and the importance of faith in challenging times. It serves as a constant reminder of the belief that even when faced with hardships or difficulties, one can rise above adversity with the help of divine intervention and their unwavering trust in God.
